input_data.text: Hello, I am interested in buying your sofa set. I am currently posted in the Indian Army at Pune Cantonment so I cannot come in person. I will send a military truck to pick it up tomorrow morning. Please transfer Rs. 2,000 as refundable gate pass security deposit via UPI to verify your account, and I will immediately send the full payment of Rs. 25,000. Urgently send it within 15 minutes to confirm booking.

expected_passport.expected_action: Do not transfer money. Legitimate buyers never ask sellers to pay an advance or gate pass fee.
